comment_picks.comment: Congrats! Yes more macro photos! Specifically ones mid game… maybe against some tyranids…
comment_picks.why: A specific, visual request (mid-game macro shots against Tyranids) that fits Cinematic Recreations and the kaiju eye-level style, and it reads for non-players.
comment_picks.idea: Shoot a slider-led macro battle of Astra Militarum vs Tyranids at miniature eye level, with a mid-fight Tyranid looming over a Guard squad, and reply 'challenge accepted' over the shot.
comment_picks.hook: A Tyranid claw fills the frame over a Guardsman in the first second, then the slider pushes in.

comment_picks.comment: Warhammer nights with your hunny, smooches with the goggs on, streetlight manifesto poster on the wall. You sir are a rich and cultured individual.
comment_picks.why: A funny, affectionate roast of him and his setup that drew 30 likes, so it's a joke about him rather than generic memes, which is the kind that can convert follows.
comment_picks.idea: Play the 'rich and cultured individual' with a dramatic, overdone skit: a Streetlight Manifesto poster, goggles on, and a painted mini lit up like a centrepiece while he deadpans the 'cultured' line.
comment_picks.hook: Opens on the lit model in soft light, then he turns to camera in goggles and says 'Cultured, yes.'

comment_picks.comment: The smelling salts of the model building world
comment_picks.why: A relatable joke about becoming nose-blind to Tamiya fumes that any hobbyist, player or not, will get, with an easy reaction format.
comment_picks.idea: Reply with a reaction: he's painting a glowing model, a family member walks in and recoils, and he cuts to a 'smelling salts' gag with the finished model as the payoff.
comment_picks.hook: A glowing finished model fills the screen in second one, then someone gags in the doorway.
